info.title: LazyApp API
info.description:
One WhatsApp API for developers, SaaS platforms and businesses.

Every endpoint is Bearer-authenticated with a LazyApp API key, returns JSON, and is scoped to the workspace and mode (`live` or `test`) the key belongs to.

post.description:
Send any supported WhatsApp message type. Set `send_at` to schedule instead of sending now, which returns `202` with a scheduled message id.

`type` defaults to `text`. Address the recipient with `to`, or with `recipient.type`/`recipient.value` to send to a BSUID.

**Required scope:** `messages:send`

post.summary: Start a call or ask permission to call
post.description:
Two kinds of request.

`type: call_permission_request` (the default) sends the WhatsApp prompt asking the person whether you may call them. Their answer arrives as the `call.permission_request` webhook.

`type: business_initiated` places a call. Send the SDP offer your WebRTC client built in `sdp_offer`; Meta's SDP answer arrives on the calls webhook and shows as `session` on [`GET /v1/calls/{call}`](#tag/calls). Without the person's permission the response is `422` with `code` `call_permission_missing`.

Requires `calling: true` on the connection, otherwise `422` with `code` `capability_unavailable`.

**Required scope:** `messages:send`
